[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/20 (Sat) 05:48  
[USER] User inquired about creating documentation of a method in TypeScript similar to C#.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] To create documentation of a method in TypeScript, use JSDoc comments.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] JSDoc comments provide a way to annotate code with information about types of parameters, return types, and additional context.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Example format for JSDoc comments:  
```php
/**
 * This is a description of your method
 * @param {string} param1 - This is a description of the first parameter
 * @param {number} param2 - This is a description of the second parameter
 * @returns {boolean} This is a description of the return value
 */
function myMethod(param1: string, param2: number): boolean {
    // Your method code here
}
```  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] When hovering over the method name in VS Code, the JSDoc comments will be displayed as a tooltip.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] You can generate documentation from JSDoc comments using tools like TypeDoc.  
[USER] User asked how to use JSDoc to comment on the different variables in an interface.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] To document variables in an interface using JSDoc, add comments to each variable using the following format:  
```css
interface MyInterface {
    /** This is a description of variable1 */
    variable1: string;
    /** This is a description of variable2 */
    variable2: number;
    /** This is a description of variable3 */
    variable3: boolean;
}
```  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Each variable in the interface can be annotated with a JSDoc comment that provides a brief description.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Example of documenting an interface with more complex types:  
```php
/**
 * This is a description of MyInterface
 */
interface MyInterface {
    /**
     * This is a description of variable1
     * @type {string}
     * @minLength 5
     * @maxLength 10
     */
    variable1: string;
    /**
     * This is a description of variable2
     * @type {number}
     * @minimum 0
     * @maximum 100
     */
    variable2: number;
    /**
     * This is a description of variable3
     * @type {boolean}
     * @default true
     */
    variable3: boolean;
}
```  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The JSDoc comments can include additional information about the type of each variable, constraints, or default values.
